INSERT INTO account_sources (
            organization_id,
            account_id,
            provider,
            crm_tenant_id,
            external_account_id,
            crm_connection_id,
            source_user_id,
            synced_at,
            data_hash,
            mapper_version,
            latest_raw_record_id,
            crm_object_source_id
         )
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3::text::crm_provider, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10, $11, $12)
         ON CONFLICT (organization_id, provider, crm_tenant_id, external_account_id)
         DO UPDATE
            SET account_id = EXCLUDED.account_id,
                crm_connection_id = EXCLUDED.crm_connection_id,
                source_user_id = EXCLUDED.source_user_id,
                synced_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.synced_at, account_sources.synced_at),
                data_hash = EXCLUDED.data_hash,
                mapper_version = EXCLUDED.mapper_version,
                latest_raw_record_id = EXCLUDED.latest_raw_record_id,
                crm_object_source_id = EXCLUDED.crm_object_source_id,
                updated_at = now()
         RETURNING id, account_id
